detail.longDescription: Hi Mastodon 👋 We're VPSPioneer, a small hosting company serving customers across Europe: web hosting, reseller hosting and cloud VPS. Here we'll share practical, no-fluff guides on Linux, server admin, Plesk, DirectAdmin, WHMCS, DNS and email deliverability, and join conversations with the # SelfHosted and # SysAdmin crowd. Guides: https:// vpspioneer.com/blog # introduction # Linux # WebHosting
